title: Work PowerShell
gloss: Documents\WindowsPowerShell on the work computer, which has no Git checkout
observed: a work copy pasted into the PowerShell outpost view
cadence: whenever a copy is pasted or an install is confirmed
outpost_protocol: by hand: pasted into the ISE and saved; no script places files, and a copy need not be byte-identical to GitHub
upkeep: review a whole file or select parsed units against a supplied work copy, then record the placement at the same scope

title: iPhone Shortcuts
gloss: the Shortcuts library on the phone
cadence: daily at 02:00 by Sync-Manifest, plus library dumps exported by hand
outpost_protocol: by a link the estate builds, tapped on the phone
upkeep: tap the Library-Replace link for the chain that is behind

title: Cloud environment
gloss: the environment settings on claude.ai, which hold two lines: one fetches the setup script from main, one checks that the plugin installed
outpost_protocol: by pull: each session fetches the setup script from main
upkeep: edit the environment settings so the next session rebuilds from main

title: claude.ai account skills
gloss: the skills on the claude.ai account, which reach chat, Cowork and cloud sessions
upkeep: upload the zip the check builds, or turn the skill off, in Customize > Skills
